sentences.text: The known skeleton of Gongxianosaurus is largely complete but lacks the hands and most of the skull.
This dinosaur may have reached a length of 14 meters.
Gongxianosaurus fossils were discovered in May 1997 during a geological exploration.
The holotype specimen of Gongxianosaurus was likely destroyed when the protective exhibition hall built over it collapsed.
Excavation of the Gongxianosaurus site recovered a wealth of fossils from an area of approximately 200 square meters.
Gongxianosaurus moved quadrupedally, with forelimbs reaching 70% to 75% of the hind limb length.
Unlike other sauropods, Gongxianosaurus lacked pleurocoels, suggesting its vertebrae were quite massive.
The pedal phalangeal formula of Gongxianosaurus is 2-3-4-5-1.
All digits of Gongxianosaurus except the outermost one ended in claws.
The chevrons of Gongxianosaurus were unbifurcated.
The genus Gongxianosaurus was established by He et al. in 1998.
The species Gongxianosaurus shibeiensis was established by He et al. in 1998.
Gongxianosaurus belongs to the parent group Sauropodiformes.
Gongxianosaurus is classified within the dinosaur class Saurischia.
The type species of the genus Gongxianosaurus is Gongxianosaurus shibeiensis.
Gongxianosaurus lived during the early Jurassic Period, specifically the Sinemurian to Pliensbachian stages.
Gongxianosaurus lived in what is now Asia.
Gongxianosaurus lived during the Toarcian stage, between 184.2 and 174.7 million years ago.
It is debated whether some fossils belong to Gongxianosaurus shibeiensis or a second species, with Ouyang Hui informally naming the latter Yibinosaurus zhoui.
